title: Safer AI Future
primary_theme: AI safety investing to protect humanity from powerful autonomous technologies
founder_lessons: Build products that counter concrete AI failure modes, not just products that exploit AI capabilities.
Recognize AI as more than an efficiency tool because it can increasingly act independently.
Look for safety models that can scale through companies while complementing nonprofit research.
Prepare founders and leaders for a future in which AI changes every aspect of life.
notable_quotes: I am more interested in products and services that counter some of the things that can go wrong.
my goal is to do whatever I can with these community organizations, these nonprofit organizations and the for-profit organizations to help ensure this beneficial future.
